title: workflow/Genetics parameter schema
description: Parameter schema for the Genetics Nextflow pipeline.

mod.description: Pipeline mode: VCF/PLINK branch — v1_plink, test_thin, test_camp, test_common_thin, test_common_only, test_common_inter, test_common_inter_refchr, test_wap_refchr, test_wap_thin_refchr, test_hex_thin, test_wap_common_refchr, test_rare_only, test_hex, test_wap, test_wap_exon, test_collinear; or wheat_* integrated modes.

help.description: Print usage and exit when true.

mq_dir.description: Frozen site-MQ reference root (reference/, logs/). Partial task abstract_mq_50_bams only.

mq_force_rerun.description: When true, rebuild MQ even if *.site_mq.ref.* already exists under mq_dir/reference.

wheat_tsne_n_input_pcs.description: Leading PLINK PCs used as input to sklearn t-SNE in wheat_pca_tsne plots.

wheat_tsne_random_state.description: Random seed for sklearn TSNE reproducibility.

wheat_plink_source_mod.description: Genotype process mod supplying merged *_test.plink2 (e.g. test_thin, test_common_thin) for wheat_* matrix export.

wheat_integrated_mod.description: Wheat analytic mod for partial_task wheat_from_plink (e.g. wheat_pca_tsne); params.mod stays the PLINK source mod.

partial_task.description: Partial rerun selector for subworkflows/local/entry/partial_router.nf: assess_plink, assess_vcf, ld_redraw, ld_rare_common, mac_stats, mac_het_excess, mac_dist_redraw, chr_counts, chr_compare, rebuild_lib_stats, wheat_from_plink, sample_manifest, cohort_freq, annotate_vep, variant_sets, assoc_wap, phenotype_wap.

het_source_mod.description: Common-SNP process mod supplying merged *_test.plink2 for PLINK2 --het (F_panel) in mac_het_excess.

mac_het_f_grid.description: Comma-separated inbreeding coefficients swept in addition to the data-estimated F_panel.

mac_het_p_thresholds.description: Comma-separated P_excess thresholds for the retain/drop sweep (no filtered pfile is written).

mac_het_retain_alpha.description: P_excess retain threshold for MAC heatmaps and popdep het-filter scatters.

mac_het_sweep.description: Run the excess-het retain/drop probability sweep in mac_het_excess.

mac_het_heatmap.description: Draw MAC vs H and MAC vs H/MAC heatmaps in mac_het_excess.

mac_het_popdep_scatter.description: Draw test_rare_only popdep mean/SD and mean/CV scatters (linear and log-log) coloured by the excess-het retain/drop call. Requires filled process/<mod>/variant/*.popdep.info.tsv.

mac_het_rh_diag.description: Classify MAC vs H into bottom / middle / diagonal R_H=H/MAC bands; write robust F (excluding all-het sites) and depth/MQ/missing enrichment. Optional MAPQ>=30 popdep via mac_het_popdep_mapq30_mod.

mac_het_rh_sample.description: When mac_het_rh_diag is on, run PLINK2 --het on all-het (H=MAC, MAC>=5) sites and plot per-sample heterozygous burden.

mac_het_popdep_mapq30_mod.description: Process mod supplying MAPQ>=30 *.popdep.info.tsv for R_H band depth comparison (e.g. test_rare_only_mapq30). Genotypes stay on mac_het_variant_mod / params.mod.

test_wap_common_maf.description: test_wap_common_refchr: plink2 --maf on WAP-panel frequencies at extract from main_raw (keep MAF >= this).

test_wap_common_target_n.description: Approximate genome-wide variant target used to set test_wap_common_thin_rate.

test_wap_common_thin_rate.description: test_wap_common_refchr plink2 --thin after --maf. Calibrated so retained sites are ~2e6 given the observed MAF>=0.05 rate on test_wap.

test_set_target_n.description: Genome-wide ABD target for oversized mixed-MAF test sets (test_wap_thin_refchr, test_hex_thin). One keep rate = target / ABD count, applied to every chromosome.

test_set_max_n.description: Skip extra thinning when A+B+D already has at most this many sites (upper end of the 2–3M test-set band).

collinear_root.description: Existing collinear prep tree (extract/, …) for test_collinear when --collinear_skip_prep is set.

collinear_skip_prep.description: Skip collinear_sites_prep and reuse --collinear_root for test_collinear.

collinear_extract_dir.description: Directory of chrNNN.collinear.txt extract lists (defaults to collinear_root/extract).

collinear_target_n.description: Target variant count after MAF filter + proportional sample for test_collinear.

collinear_maf_threshold.description: Minimum MAF for collinear candidate sites before sampling.

collinear_force.description: Force rebuild of cached collinear prep artefacts.

test_popdep_target_bp.description: Random popdep sites for test_popdep (genome-wide, not variants).

test_popdep_seed.description: RNG seed for test_popdep site sampling.

test_popdep_te_gff.description: IWGSC RefSeq v1.0 CLARITE transposable-element GFF3 (repeat class).

test_popdep_gap_bed.description: AGP gap BED (chr1A linear, 0-based) for the gap class.

test_popdep_fasta.description: IWGSC v1.0 ABD FASTA used to derive extreme-GC windows.

test_popdep_mapq_dir.description: Directory of allmapq_1mb.chr*.popdep_bins.tsv used as the CNV class.

syntenic_matrix_dir.description: Directory of *.syntenic.matrix.tsv.gz for full-lineage collinear prep.

full_lineage_summary_tsv.description: Summary TSV from full-lineage count (species columns per subgenome).

main_raw_dir.description: main_raw process root for collinear overlap with published variant tables.

aneuploidy_breachr_input_dir.description: Directory with breachr_reconcile_all.tsv for confirmed aneuploidy chromosome plot (defaults to stats/<mod>/info/breachr_check).

aneuploidy_plot_title.description: Optional plot title override for confirmed aneuploidy chromosome distribution.

aneuploidy_plot_id.description: Output prefix for confirmed aneuploidy plot/tables (defaults to params.job).

ld_block_snp_window.description: PLINK 1.9 --ld-window (SNP count) for Circos LD-block r2/D' pairs.

ld_block_window_kb.description: PLINK 1.9 --ld-window-kb for Circos LD-block r2/D' pairs.

circos_ld_map_plot_only.description: Replot Circos rare/common/LD-block map from published stats/<mod>/info/all.variant.circos_ld_map.{density,blocks}.info.tsv.

circos_ld_block_coverage_frac.description: Paint a circos_bin_bp window as an LD block when unioned SNP-block coverage is at least this fraction of the window; adjacent passing windows are merged.

circos_ld_mod.description: Optional process-tree mod for Circos LD-block bfiles and *.info.ld_block.ld (e.g. test_wap_common_refchr). Density still uses --mod. Defaults to --mod.

ld_decay_r2_threshold.description: Pair-weighted mean r2 threshold for fine-bin all-pairs decay distance.

ld_decay_fine_bin_kb.description: Bin width (kb) for fine-bin mean-r2 threshold distance. Does not overwrite ld_decay_bin_kb=50 artefacts.

ld_decay_fine_max_kb.description: Max distance (kb) when scanning for ld_decay_r2_threshold on all-pairs vcor.

tajima_d_window_bp.description: vcftools --TajimaD window size in bp for stacked A/B/D Tajima D plots (tmp subgenome_maf_tajima.nf).

tajima_d_plot_only.description: Replot stacked Tajima D from published *.Tajima.D without PLINK2 VCF export.

ld_decay_maf_scatter_points.description: Random pair cap for the MAF-vs-MAF scatter coloured by LD r2. Pair table is *.maf_scatter.info.tsv (IDs, global MAF, pairwise-complete MAF, N_PAIRWISE, r2, r2_max).

ld_along_chr_n_focal.description: Legacy even-sample count per chromosome. Along-chr LD now uses ld_along_chr_n_focal_per_bin.

ld_along_chr_n_focal_per_bin.description: Focals sampled in each spatial bin. Each focal uses the full --ld-window-kb, not just sites inside the bin. Then the bin value is the mean decay-to-r2 distance of those focals.

ld_along_chr_spatial_bin_mb.description: Along-chromosome window (Mb) for averaging focal decay distances.

ld_along_chr_max_kb.description: PLINK2 --ld-window-kb and max distance when finding where mean r2 falls to ld_along_chr_r2.

ld_along_chr_r2.description: Mean r2 threshold for along-chromosome LD decay distance.

ld_along_chr_chromosomes.description: Comma-separated vmap4 chromosome names. Along-chr plots stack chr1-chr7 in one PNG per A/B/D subgenome.

popdep_min_mapq.description: TIGER PopDep/PopDepFull/PopDepCrossChr -g: minimum samtools MAPQ (depth -q). 0 = no MAPQ filter.

wgs_core_groups.description: sample_group labels that form the WGS-core frequency/QC panel (includes WAP).

assoc_groups.description: sample_group labels allowed into association tests. Default WAP.

dual_af_rare_max.description: MAF upper bound used to flag rare sites in WGS-core vs WAP AF join.

wgs_afreq.description: PLINK2 afreq for the WGS-core keep set (dual_af_from_afreq.nf).

wap_afreq.description: PLINK2 afreq for the WAP keep set (dual_af_from_afreq.nf).

ref_v1_gff.description: IWGSC v1.1 GFF with vmap4 numeric chromosome IDs (wheat_v1.1_Lulab.gff3).

ref_v1_gff_hc.description: Official IWGSC v1.1 HC GFF (chr1A names).

cohort_freq_cohorts.description: Cohorts to compute PLINK2 --freq for in partial_task cohort_freq.

snpeff_genome.description: Custom SnpEff genome name built from the Lulab GFF and ABD FASTA.

snpeff_genome_dir.description: Existing SnpEff data dir (snpEff.config + data/). Default {home_dir}/00data/03ref/07snpeff when present, else process/{mod}/annotate/snpeff_genome.

snpeff_jar.description: SnpEff jar matching the prebuilt genome. Default the 4.3t jar under 00data/03ref/07snpeff; else conda snpEff.

test_wap_exon_gff.description: GFF for test_wap_exon BED extract. Default params.ref_v1_gff.

test_wap_exon_gff_type.description: Comma-separated GFF types to extract (exon includes UTR).

vep_from_mod.description: Pfile mod whose variant IDs are turned into sites VCFs for VEP. Alternative to vep_vcf.

vep_subgenomes.description: Comma-separated subgenomes to annotate under vep_from_mod, e.g. 'A,B' or 'Others'.

vep_vcf.description: Single VCF annotated by partial_task annotate_vep (e.g. main_raw/chr032.vcf.gz).

vep_id.description: Output id for annotate_vep. Default from the VCF name.

vep_gff.description: GFF for VEP. Default params.ref_v1_gff (numeric chromosome IDs).

vep_prepared_gff.description: Already sorted/bgzipped/tabix-indexed GFF; skips the prepare step.

vep_fields.description: VEP --tab columns. No Ensembl cache for wheat, so SIFT/PolyPhen are unavailable.

vep_extra_args.description: Extra flags appended to the vep command.

site_anno_from_mod.description: Mod whose pfiles supply the variant positions. Null uses params.mod.

site_anno_subgenomes.description: Comma-separated subgenomes. Null runs A,B,D; Others has no featHighRes source.

site_anno_phylop_min.description: Monocot phyloP cut used with phastCons to call a site conserved.

site_anno_phastcons_min.description: Monocot phastCons cut used with phyloP to call a site conserved.

site_anno_gerp_min.description: GERP score that calls a site conserved on its own.

gene_expr_tpm.description: Comma-separated TPM matrices, used instead of gene_expr_from_dir.

gene_expr_metadata.description: Sample metadata table. Null picks up default_metadata.txt beside the matrices.

gene_expr_gff.description: GFF3 supplying the v1.0 to v1.1 gene map via previous_id. Null uses ref_v1_gff.

gene_expr_detect_min.description: TPM at or above which a gene counts as expressed in a sample.

variant_sets_from_mod.description: Mod whose publish tree supplies per-subgenome VEP tables and cohort afreq pairs.

variant_sets_wgs_cohort.description: Cohort name for the WGS-side afreq under variant_sets_from_mod.

variant_sets_wap_cohort.description: Cohort name for the WAP-side afreq under variant_sets_from_mod.

variant_sets_names.description: Subset of set names (e.g. plof_rare_wgs,neutral_4fold). Null keeps all.

variant_sets_common_min.description: MAF lower bound for the common_wap frequency class.

variant_sets_site_anno.description: One *.site_anno.tsv for the single-pair input mode.

variant_sets_site_anno_dir.description: Folder of per-subgenome *.site_anno.tsv. Null uses the from_mod stats info folder.

assoc_wap_keep.description: Keep list for assoc_wap. Default assoc.keep.

assoc_wap_pheno.description: PLINK2 pheno file from partial_task phenotype_wap.

assoc_wap_covar.description: Optional covariate file (e.g. PLINK2 PCs). Overrides assoc_wap_pca.

assoc_wap_pca.description: Compute LD-pruned PCs on the WAP panel and use them as GLM covariates.

assoc_wap_pca_maf.description: MAF floor for the variants entering the WAP structure PCA.

assoc_wap_pca_source.description: Merged subgenome pfile supplying the structure PCs, reused across subgenomes.

assoc_wap_burden.description: Run the rare-variant gene burden track instead of the single-variant GLM.

assoc_wap_burden_set.description: variant_sets set name to collapse, e.g. plof_rare_wap. Required with --assoc_wap_burden.

assoc_wap_burden_extract.description: One explicit *.extract list. Default discovers {id}.{set}.extract per subgenome.

assoc_wap_burden_collapse.description: Gene score rule: sum of minor alleles, or a 0/1 carrier indicator.

assoc_wap_burden_gff.description: GFF for gene-level Manhattan loci. Default params.ref_v1_gff_hc (chr1A names).

phenotype_wap_input.description: Wide phenotype table for partial_task phenotype_wap.

phenotype_wap_traits.description: Comma-separated trait columns. Null keeps every non-ID column.

phenotype_wap_aggregate_duplicates.description: Average repeated sample rows instead of keeping the first.

singer_source_mod.description: Merged *_test.plink2 source for the SINGER 2 Mb window (tmp singer_arg_common_inter.nf).

singer_plink_chr.description: PLINK --chr token in the source pvar (numeric 1 = chr1A on test_common_inter_refchr).

singer_keep.description: Optional PLINK2 --keep file for the SINGER window.

singer_n_windows.description: Number of 2 Mb SINGER windows to scatter.

singer_min_snps.description: Minimum SNPs in a 2 Mb bin to be eligible.

singer_germplasm_tsv.description: WAP r1 germplasm TSV (r1_id, country). Default ~/git/DBone/.../wap_r1_germplasm_table.tsv.

singer_from_beagle.description: Skip extract/phase/Beagle; run SINGER on published *.beagle.vcf.gz for windows missing singer_*_nodes_0.txt.

singer_seed.description: Fixed SINGER -seed. Null draws our own random seeds (not singer_master -debug, not 42).

singer_seed_attempts.description: How many of our random -seed values to try per failed window when singer_seed is null.

singer_relate_n_positions.description: Local trees per ARG window when ranking sample TMRCA.

singer_relate_top_k.description: Nearest neighbors to keep per sample.

singer_bin_dir.description: Folder with singer_master and the singer binary. Default {home_dir}/00data/software/singer-0.1.9-linux.
